description: Works out the dates the main pre-action protocols in England and Wales set after a letter of claim, counted the way each protocol words them, with the paragraph for each: housing conditions (20 working days from receipt, deemed 2 days after the letter's date; inspection; expert's report), clinical disputes (14 days from receipt; Letter of Response 4 months from the letter of claim, and from receipt), personal injury (21 calendar days from posting; 3 months from the acknowledgment), disease and illness including hearing loss (21 days from posting; 90 days from the acknowledgment), professional negligence, construction and engineering, debt claims, and the Practice Direction where no protocol applies. Flags dates that fall on a weekend or bank holiday (protocol periods do not roll forward).

ackDate.description: Personal injury, disease and professional negligence: the date of the defendant's acknowledgment (YYYY-MM-DD).

foreign.description: Personal injury and disease: the accident or negligence was abroad, or the defendant is outside England and Wales.

inspectionDate.description: Housing: the date of the inspection, for the expert's report (YYYY-MM-DD).

letterDate.description: Housing, clinical and debt: the date of the letter of claim (YYYY-MM-DD).

protocol.description: The protocol: "housing" (Housing conditions (disrepair), England or Wales), "clinical" (Clinical disputes (clinical negligence)), "pi" (Personal injury), "disease" (Disease and illness (including hearing loss)), "profneg" (Professional negligence), "construction" (Construction and engineering), "debt" (Debt claims (business against an individual)), "none" (No specific protocol (the Practice Direction)).

receivedDate.description: Clinical, professional negligence, construction and no protocol: the date the letter of claim was received (YYYY-MM-DD).

recordsDate.description: Clinical and disease: the date the records were requested (YYYY-MM-DD).

replyDate.description: Debt: the date the completed Reply Form was received (YYYY-MM-DD).

responseDate.description: Housing: the date of the landlord's response, for the inspection (YYYY-MM-DD).

sentDate.description: Personal injury and disease: the date the letter of claim was posted or sent (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: calculate_pre_action_protocol_deadlines
title: Pre-action protocol deadline calculator
